notes: Mission Produce Inc. (NASDAQ: AVO). Vertically integrated avocado grower / packer / global distributor with company-owned orchards in California, Mexico, Peru and Guatemala plus a global ripening/distribution network. Pivoted into mangoes and blueberries (2020s diversification). IPO Sep 2020. Fiscal year ends October 31. Data from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001802974) — figures match consolidated statements. EBITDA = operating income + D&A. Net debt = LongTermDebtNoncurrent + LongTermDebtCurrent − cash & cash equivalents. Two reportable segments: (i) Marketing & Distribution (avocado/mango sales — bulk of revenue), (ii) International Farming (Peru orchard production sold mostly intersegment to M&D). Blueberries segment added FY24 (Peru). Mission's owned/managed orchard footprint ~12k+ acres with bulk in Peru.

periods.notes: FY21 (year ended Oct 31, 2021): post-IPO first full year. Revenue $891.7M; op income $60.9M + D&A $20.4M = EBITDA $81.3M. Net debt $79.4M. Per-pound avocado pricing strong in late FY21.
FY22: revenue +17% on Mexican price spike but op loss −$37.2M (Peru smaller harvest, abrupt avocado price collapse Q4). EBITDA −$12.4M. Net loss −$34.6M, EPS −$0.49. Wettest pivot year of cycle.
FY23: revenue −9% YoY ($953.9M). Op income $6.9M + D&A $32.8M = EBITDA $39.7M (recovery vs FY22 disaster). Net loss −$2.8M. Mango segment launched.

FY24: revenue +29% to $1.23B on Mexico avocado per-lb price inflation + Peru recovery. EBITDA $103.4M (op income $65.7M + D&A $37.7M). Net income $36.7M, EPS $0.52. Net debt down to $55.7M. First Peru blueberry harvest contributed.

FY25: record revenue $1.39B (+13% YoY) on volume growth & favorable pricing. Op income $65.2M + D&A $34.6M = EBITDA $99.8M. Net income $37.7M, EPS $0.53. Net debt $31.0M, lowest since IPO. Blueberry segment scaling.
